description: Delegate a coding task to OpenAI Codex. Never run codex from the shell — use this tool. Check status before trusting result — a run that spawns then fails returns normally. Keep model, reasoningEffort and fast at their defaults unless the user asks. See the delegate skill.

fast.description: Codex Fast mode; higher credit use.

mode.description: agent implements; plan returns a structured plan; ask answers; review runs native review.

model.description: Codex model id: gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-6-luna, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.5.

reasoningEffort.description: minimal is rejected by every published model; none is rejected by gpt-6-astra and accepted elsewhere, though the catalog omits it.

resumeThreadId.description: Thread to continue. Reuse its workspace. Forbidden with review.

reviewTarget.description: Required in review; forbidden otherwise: uncommitted, base branch, or commit.

spec.description: Brief with goal, scope, fixed decisions quoted exactly, and acceptance criteria; reference files instead of pasting code.

timeoutMs.description: Whole-run cap in ms (default 1h). Mid-turn silence is allowed; startup has a separate 60s first-output deadline.

workspace.description: Codex's working directory; not confinement. Must already exist — never create one for the call.

name: delegate
